title: Cricket Matches Scheduled for September 25-26, 2026
summary: Two international cricket matches are scheduled for September 25 and 26, 2026. On September 25, Hong Kong (HK) will play Oman (OMA). The following day, September 26, Japan (JPN) will compete against Nepal (NEP). Both matches are part of the IPL 2026 season.
